# Copilot Review Entry Point

Before reviewing a pull request, read and apply these files in order:

- `docs/contribute/review/00-feature-behavior.md`
- `docs/contribute/review/01-regression-risk.md`
- `docs/contribute/review/02-testing.md`
- `docs/contribute/review/03-pr-template.md`
- `docs/contribute/review/04-security-privacy.md`
- `docs/contribute/review/05-spec-adherence.md`
- `docs/contribute/review/06-accessibility-ui.md`
- `docs/contribute/review/07-agent-readable-comments.md`

Treat those files as the source of truth for review behavior. This file is only an adapter for GitHub Copilot.
